scripts.patch:permissions: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),b=x=>Buffer.from(x,'base64').toString('utf8'),p='src/pages/Users.tsx';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!s.includes('saveSupervisorPermissions'))s=s.replace("  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);",b('')+'\n'+'  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);');if(!s.includes('صلاحيات الأقسام'))s=s.replace("                      {/* Ban / Unban */}",b('')+'\n'+'                      {/* Ban / Unban */}');fs.writeFileSync(p,s)"
scripts.prepare:routes: pnpm run patch:permissions && node scripts/register-travel-agency-requests.mjs && node scripts/apply-archive-db-persistence.mjs && node scripts/register-lawyer-subscriptions.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm run patch:permissions && node scripts/register-travel-agency-requests.mjs && node scripts/apply-archive-db-persistence.mjs && node scripts/register-lawyer-subscriptions.mjs && vite --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: pnpm run patch:permissions && node scripts/register-travel-agency-requests.mjs && node scripts/apply-archive-db-persistence.mjs && node scripts/register-lawyer-subscriptions.mjs && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run patch:permissions && node scripts/register-travel-agency-requests.mjs && node scripts/apply-archive-db-persistence.mjs && node scripts/register-lawyer-subscriptions.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
